A few minutes away from Agio Anargyron square, in the very heart of Psiri, this 70m2 loft will immediately captivate a contemporary art lover.
The flat is next to the hustle and bustle of this alternative neighbourhood with its bars and tavernas and yet on a calmer street; best of both worlds!  Highlights of Street Art are on this very street whilst views of the Acropolis from this side of Psiri are just magical.
The loft is on the 3rd and last floor of a very well kept  building enjoying a beautiful  common  terrace.  The building use to contain a factory of painting brushes and some features at the entrance will transport you back in history.  The loft, which is reached by a staircase, has an open plan living space opening up to a very large 25m2 balcony.  The bedroom is separated by a blackout curtain.  There is also a walk-in closet and a modern bathroom.   The whole property is flooded by natural light and its minimal layout and decorations makes it airy and functional .  Terrazo flooring has been renovated giving it an overall  clean cut. It is rented out furnished with a fully equipped kitchen, cabinets in its modern bathroom, a living room with large sofa and dining table with chairs, a study area with a desk  as well as a queen size bed.
The common terrace with its breathtaking views of the Akropolis  is accessed by the same wide and comfortable staircase and it is the perfect spot to sunbathe or have an apéritif.
